notes: New Decompiler: drop in a .NET program, Java or Kotlin jar, Minecraft mod or plugin, Android app or Electron app and read its source in a built-in viewer. It tells you what the file is, flags code worth a look (like Discord webhooks or password grabbing), and zips the source into Downloads. Everything stays on your PC. Also: a new logo, a smooth close animation, and sidebar categories you can fold.
